name: GitHub Issue Complexity Analyser

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub personal access token (needs Issues: read/write, Contents: read). Also used for Copilot SDK auth.

onCreateCommand: python3 -m pip install -U uv && python3 -m uv sync
postCreateCommand: sh -lc 'token=${GH_TOKEN:-$GITHUB_TOKEN}; if [ -n "$token" ]; then echo "GitHub token found in environment; using env-based gh auth."; else echo "No GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN found; skipping token-based gh auth setup."; fi; if gh copilot --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "gh copilot is available (built-in or installed extension)."; else gh extension list | grep -q "github/gh-copilot" || gh extension install github/gh-copilot; fi'
postStartCommand:
echo '✅ Dev Container Ready!

📌 Quick Start Commands:
  python app.py hello              # Simple SDK call
  python app.py hello-stream       # Streaming example
  python app.py serve              # Start web UI (http://localhost:8000)
  python app.py <github_issue_url> # Analyse GitHub issue

🔐 If GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN is set, gh uses env-based auth and the Copilot CLI extension is ensured
🐛 Use F5 to start the debug server
'
